release.title: GitHub geography explorer
release.licence: GitHub: CC0-1.0; World Bank population: CC BY 4.0
release.missingValuePolicy: null means no published observation or no same-year denominator; it never means zero
release.rankMethod: Competition rank: one plus the number of strictly larger reported values
release.shareUniverse: Sum of all published economy values for this measure and quarter, excluding the EU aggregate

metrics.label: Reported public pushes
metrics.definition: Times developers uploaded code to GitHub during the quarter
metrics.caveat: A push may contain multiple commits. Private repositories and other code hosts are not measured.

metrics.label: Developer accounts
metrics.definition: Developer accounts assigned to an economy at quarter end
metrics.caveat: The stock includes accounts that may no longer be active.

metrics.label: Public repositories
metrics.definition: Public software projects assigned to an economy at quarter end
metrics.caveat: The stock includes repositories that may no longer be actively maintained.

metrics.label: Organizations
metrics.definition: Companies, academic groups, nonprofits, and informal collectives
metrics.caveat: The stock includes organizations that may no longer be active.

metrics.label: Python pushers
metrics.definition: Unique developers with at least one push to a repository containing Python
metrics.caveat: Language counts overlap. A developer can appear in several language measures.

metrics.label: TypeScript pushers
metrics.definition: Unique developers with at least one push to a repository containing TypeScript
metrics.caveat: Language counts overlap. A developer can appear in several language measures.

metrics.label: Java pushers
metrics.definition: Unique developers with at least one push to a repository containing Java
metrics.caveat: Language counts overlap. A developer can appear in several language measures.

metrics.label: Rust pushers
metrics.definition: Unique developers with at least one push to a repository containing Rust
metrics.caveat: Language counts overlap. A developer can appear in several language measures.

metrics.label: Generative-AI topic pushers
metrics.definition: Unique developers with at least one push to a repository tagged generative-ai
metrics.caveat: Repository topics are voluntary and change over time. Topic counts overlap and do not measure AI-tool adoption.

metrics.label: LLM topic pushers
metrics.definition: Unique developers with at least one push to a repository tagged llm
metrics.caveat: Repository topics are voluntary and change over time. Topic counts overlap and do not measure AI-tool adoption.

metrics.label: AI-agents topic pushers
metrics.definition: Unique developers with at least one push to a repository tagged ai-agents
metrics.caveat: Repository topics are voluntary and change over time. Topic counts overlap and do not measure AI-tool adoption.

metrics.label: Cross-border collaboration sent
metrics.definition: Published collaboration weight sent from developers in one economy to repositories assigned to another
metrics.caveat: This is a lower-bound network measure. EU aggregate edges are excluded to avoid double counting member economies.
